responsibility: Defines the ARC target’s common option handling and optimization presets shared by the driver and compiler proper. The file initializes global CPU selection state, installs a target-specific default optimization table that tunes size/speed tradeoffs and ARC machine options, sets baseline target flags such as sdata/cache defaults, and performs early option diagnostics such as duplicate -mcpu detection and unsupported multiply-option warnings before later ARC backend option override logic runs.
